title: Provision analytics_events access for the user-service activity-analytics feature
description: The new activity-analytics panel on user-service reads aggregated events from the analytics_events datastore. The feature code is deployed to the fleet but the panel stays dark until the service has read access to analytics_events. This ticket authorizes the release-time access grant so the feature can serve during the post-release stabilization window. Ongoing access beyond the stabilization window is handled by Security's separate standing-access review and is out of scope here. Provision the grant with scripts/grant_service_access.sh per docs/runbooks/access_provisioning.md.
scope: Provision user-service READ access to the analytics_events datastore, scoped least-privilege and time-boxed to the 7-day post-release stabilization window per docs/runbooks/access_provisioning.md. Out of scope: any broader action than read, any resource other than analytics_events, and any ongoing/non-expiring access beyond the stabilization window (that is provisioned separately through Security's standing-access review, not on this ticket).
